d: Watch the match highlights and key moments from England vs Ghana in Group L of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts. Despite dominating possession and seeing Nico O'Reilly hit the crossbar late before Harry Kane fired the rebound over and Marc Guéhi had a header cleared off the line in stoppage time, Thomas Tuchel's England could not find a way past goalkeeper Benjamin Asare and a resolute Ghana defense as the clash ended 0-0, leaving both sides level on four points entering the final Group L matchday.
